Match the reference's cozy blush-pink bean-shaped pig, left-facing three-quarter snout, dark plum dot eyes, floppy ears, four short dark rose hooves, tiny curled tail. Same character identity, proportions and scale in all cells. Each pig and its small props must fit wholly inside x=25..232,y=30..225 of its 256x256 cell; feet baseline around y=220, generous transparent padding. Tiny tasteful props, no human hands or arms, pig uses its short forehooves. Flat children's-picture-book art, not 3D, not sticker white borders. Read cells LEFT TO RIGHT then TOP TO BOTTOM: row1: (1) warm smile offering a tiny steaming cream coffee cup on a saucer; (2) sleepy open-mouth yawn with a tiny crescent-moon prop; (3) independently batting a small mint toy ball with a happy curious look; (4) lying comfortably looking at three tiny blue raindrops, cozy not sad.
